np2-broadcasting.def: NumPy's rule for combining arrays of different shapes: align shapes on the right; sizes must be equal or 1; size-1 axes are virtually stretched.

np2-standardise.def: Subtract each column's mean and divide by its standard deviation, so every column has mean 0 and standard deviation 1 (z-scores).

np2-prng.def: A deterministic formula whose output looks random; the same starting state (seed) always gives the same sequence.

np2-seed.def: The integer that sets a random generator's starting state; fixing it makes random results reproducible.

np2-generator.def: The object returned by np.random.default_rng(seed); draw numbers with its methods such as normal, uniform, choice, permutation.

np2-kwarg.def: A function argument given by name, e.g. scale=5; can be given in any order. Arguments matched by position are positional.

np2-lstsq.def: Choosing coefficients that minimise the sum of squared errors; solution \(\hat\bbeta=(\bX\T\bX)^{-1}\bX\T\by\); NumPy np.linalg.lstsq.

np2-dot.def: \(\mathbf a\cdot\mathbf b=\sum_i a_ib_i\): multiply matching entries and add. NumPy a @ b.

np2-matmul.def: \((\mathbf{AB})_{ij}\) = row \(i\) of A dotted with column \(j\) of B; shapes \((m\times k)(k\times n)\to(m\times n)\). NumPy A @ B.

np2-norm.def: The length of a vector: L2 \(\sqrt{\sum x_i^2}\), L1 \(\sum|x_i|\). NumPy np.linalg.norm.
